snippet.title: Skullgirls - 2008 Trailer
snippet.description: A once-lost 2008 trailer for Skullgirls, made several years before it was picked up by Autumn. Notice that Valentine and Double are absent! Squigly and Umbrella originally were in their spots on the roster.
